scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install --include=dev
scripts.dev: npm run stop:ports && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3001 -t 60000 && npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=development CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:5173 SERVE_CLIENT=0 npm run dev
scripts.app: npm run build --prefix frontend && cross-env SERVE_CLIENT=1 electron .
scripts.web: npm run build --prefix frontend && cross-env SERVE_CLIENT=1 NODE_ENV=production CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:3001 concurrently -k "npm run web:server" "npm run web:open"
scripts.app:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:3001/api/health && cross-env DESKTOP_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.stop:ports: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=3001,5173; foreach($port in $p){ Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Host 'Ports 3001 et 5173 liberes.'"
scripts.web:https: npm run ssl:generate && npm run build --prefix frontend && cross-env SERVE_CLIENT=1 NODE_ENV=production BMB_URL=https://localhost:3001 concurrently -k "npm run web:server" "wait-on https://localhost:3001/api/health -t 120000 --insecure && cross-env BMB_URL=https://localhost:3001 node scripts/open-browser.js"
